title: 权威删除终态

revalidation_2026-09-05.command: go test internal/authoritativeremoval -count=1 (also PASS inside the 2026-09-05 preflight)

implementation: 仅接受 UNKNOWN/EXPIRED_UNKNOWN Attempt 与 Job
要求完整且明确的权威 qB 删除事实
要求同 StorageTarget 下新鲜 TRUSTED physical_free，并校验 generation/revision/digest
校验 binding owner、StorageTarget、qB torrent ID 与 identity key 全链路一致
单个 BEGIN IMMEDIATE 事务删除 binding、释放 Reservation 并收敛 Attempt/Job
TERMINAL_QB_REMOVED 保留 reflected_physical_bytes=0，单独记录未消费字节
删除事实不确定、证据陈旧或身份歧义均 fail-closed，保持 Reservation
blocker: CAP-13 capacity reconciler、后续状态机和真实 Add 接线尚未实现；本项不开放真实 qB/qui 路径。
